{{Top|leg}}
'''Republic Scout Service''' or '''Republic Scouting Service''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was an exploration organization funded by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], succeeding the [[Republic Astrogation Survey Team]] of c.[[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. They maintained extensive databanks of information on all known [[Planet/Legends|planets]], colonies, and [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] in the [[Republic Scout Service Database]]. At the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was most likely converted into the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]].

[[Halka Four-Den/Legends|Halka Four-Den]], who disappeared on a expedition to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], was a member of the Republic Scout Service.<ref name="EGWT" />

As a former member of the Scout Service, [[Mal Biron]] preferred to dress in khaki, the color of its field uniform.
